request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and soulful, upright bass, piano, brush drums, saxophone, light jazz mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He prayed for friends who spoke of blame
The Lord restored his lost estate
Twice as much as he had known
A blessing greater than before

[Verse]
Shepherds counted flocks in rows
Camels and oxen under sun
He saw his children grow
And lived to see the fourth

[Chorus]
Keziah was his second girl
A name like spice that fills the air
No women matched their beauty there
His daughters shared the land and care

[Verse]
Jemimah led the line
Keren-happuch brought the close
Three sisters in his house of joy
With silver rings and peace

[Chorus]
Keziah was his second girl
A name like spice that fills the air
No women matched their beauty there
His daughters shared the land and care

[Bridge]
One hundred forty years
He watched his family tree
Old and full of days
He finally found his rest

[Outro]
Old and full of days
Keziah in the light
